exposure: kitomes (contaminants in DNA extraction kits and reagents)
outcome: Presence of a distinct placental microbiome
Differences in placental microbiome composition between groups
cohort: 30 mothers (10 normal weight, 10 obese, 10 with GDM) undergoing elective cesarean section at term
finding: After eliminating contamination from DNA extraction kits and well-to-well contamination ('splashome'), a unique placental microbiome distinct from contaminants could not be identified.
